verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a JavaScript library driven entirely through its public programmatic API. The repo documents that API surface: reactive state with automatic dependency tracking, Context and Stores, Resources with Suspense, SSR and isomorphic rendering, custom renderers, and TypeScript/JSX configuration via jsxImportSource. One community user complains of lacking docs and a non-intuitive API, which lowers confidence but does not contradict that the API exists and is documented. Missing for 10: evidence of a dedicated, in-depth API reference beyond README highlights, independent corroboration of documentation quality, and any evidence of AI- or agent-oriented usage of the API.
